research_boundary: Bounded evidence map separating five translational stages across verified public records and trials. Does not rank therapies, compare effect sizes across incompatible scales, propose wet-lab protocols, or infer clinical benefit from registry entries.

stages_catalog.S1_cell_correction_or_expression: Cellular DNA/RNA editing, transduction, or CFTR transcript/protein expression in the studied system.
stages_catalog.S2_restored_channel_function: Measured CFTR ion-channel function or swelling assay response in cells or organoids.
stages_catalog.S3_in_vivo_airway_delivery: Administered in vivo airway delivery (nebulization or respiratory vector administration).
stages_catalog.S4_durability_or_redosing_persistence: Multi-dose regimen or persistence beyond acute transient delivery.
stages_catalog.S5_clinical_benefit_or_lung_function: Measured clinical spirometry or patient-level pulmonary endpoint in a clinical study.
